protocol.purpose: Search for a causal, literature-grounded, long-only Finly shadow candidate that historically beats SPY net of a common execution and cost model without hiding leverage, a QQQ tilt, or data leakage.
protocol.claim_boundary: The designer already knows broad market history and prior Finly results. No interval through 2026-08-28 is epistemically fresh. Passing historical gates earns SHADOW_ONLY; replacement requires a new prospective broker-reconciled record.

data.provider: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint adjusted close, one uniform frozen retrieval vintage
data.null_policy: omit a date unless every symbol has a finite positive adjusted close; never forward fill
data.revision_boundary: Yahoo adjusted close is revised research data, not a point-in-time archive; every response and normalized series is fingerprinted.

execution.signal_timing: signals use adjusted closes available after close t
execution.first_position_return: new weights first earn the t+1 to t+2 adjusted close return
execution.leverage_family: SPY 1.5x is a diagnostic baseline only, financed by negative BIL plus a 50 bp annual spread; no leveraged strategy is eligible for champion promotion.
execution.options_boundary: No options candidate may be promoted without timestamped historical chains, bid/ask quotes, fees, assignment rules, and simultaneous multi-leg execution evidence.

candidate_registry.formula: Every five sessions, score SPY/TLT/GLD by the positive fraction of 21/63/252-session BIL-excess trends, divide positive scores by trailing 20-session volatility, normalize, and scale down to a 10% trailing 63-session portfolio-volatility target.

Every 21 sessions, use 252-session SPY and TLT BIL-excess trend signs to cross-condition SPY/TLT signals, divide by trailing 20-session volatility, normalize, and scale down to 10% portfolio volatility.

Every 21 sessions, retain frozen Finly's SPY weight and allocate its unused sleeve to the stronger of TLT/GLD only when that asset has positive 252-session BIL-excess momentum; then apply a 10% portfolio-volatility cap.
Every five sessions, retain frozen Finly's direction score but size it with the square root of an equal blend of trailing 20- and 63-session variance, capped at one.
Every five sessions, equal-weight the contemporaneous causal portfolio weights from frozen Finly, the multi-asset trend ensemble, and the equity-bond cross-signal; do not fit combination weights.
Mean positive vote of 63/126/252-session SPY-minus-BIL log returns multiplied by a 15% trailing-20-session volatility scale capped at 1.

Every 21 sessions rank the original nine sector SPDRs by mean 63/126/252-session BIL-excess log return, require positive mean and 252-session excess, hold the top three in inverse-63-session-volatility weights, then scale down to a 15% portfolio volatility target.
Apply the same positive multi-horizon ranking to SPY/QQQ/IWM/EFA/EEM/VNQ/IEF/TLT/GLD/DBC, hold top three inverse-volatility weighted, then scale down to a 12% target.
Hold the strongest 252-session BIL-excess asset among SPY/QQQ/IWM/EFA/EEM when positive; otherwise hold the strongest positive asset among IEF/TLT/GLD or BIL, scaled down to 15% volatility.
Choose SPY or QQQ by 252-session BIL-excess momentum, require at least four of nine sectors above their own 200-session level, scale exposure smoothly with breadth and down to 15% volatility.
Average the contemporaneous causal weights of the five preceding experts and scale down to 15% portfolio volatility.

Combine the five experts with fixed-share multiplicative weights. At each rebalance update only from each expert's realized prior-period BIL-excess log return clipped to +/-10%, learning rate 1, and 5% shrinkage to uniform; then scale down to 15% portfolio volatility.

trial_accounting.rule: Every later formula, parameter, universe, manual rejection, LLM suggestion, bug-fixed rerun, cost, or schedule variant is appended before evaluation and included in deflated statistics.

selection.objective: Among candidates passing development and validation gates, maximize the smaller annualized log-growth advantage over SPY; use BIL-excess Sharpe then drawdown as deterministic tie breakers.
selection.recent_interval_role: May veto a hard safety failure after selection; cannot improve score, rescue failure, or break a tie.

raw_return: net annualized log growth exceeds SPY in development and validation
validation advantage is at least 0.50 percentage points per year after 5 bp one-way costs
median raw excess is positive in annual-origin 252/504/756-session families
at least 60% of windows in every family beat SPY
risk: candidate annualized volatility does not exceed SPY
candidate maximum drawdown is no worse than SPY by more than two percentage points
validation BIL-excess Sharpe exceeds frozen Finly and the long-only volatility-target baseline by at least 0.10
worst completed three-year BIL-excess log growth is positive
maximum drawdown is no worse than frozen Finly by over two points and never worse than 15%
robustness: conclusion sign survives all 21 rebalance offsets
Deflated-Sharpe probability is at least 0.95 using the cumulative trial count
shared circular-block familywise p-value is at most 0.05 at 5/20/60-session blocks

dataset.provider: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint adjusted close

qqq_buy_hold.mechanism: 100% QQQ buy and hold; exposes technology/growth tilt

spy_levered_150.mechanism: 150% SPY financed through negative BIL plus a fixed borrowing spread

spy_vol_target_15.mechanism: SPY scaled down to a 15% trailing 20-session volatility target; no leverage

frozen_finly.mechanism: 21/63/252 SPY-minus-BIL trend vote, 10% volatility target, no leverage

multi_asset_trend_ensemble.mechanism: SPY/TLT/GLD positive multi-horizon trend scores, inverse-volatility weights, 10% portfolio target

equity_bond_cross_signal.mechanism: 252-session equity and bond trends cross-condition SPY/TLT inverse-volatility weights

defensive_sleeve_rotation.mechanism: Frozen Finly equity sleeve plus positive 252-session TLT/GLD rotation in residual capital

dual_horizon_volatility_finly.mechanism: Frozen Finly direction with an equal-variance blend of 20- and 63-session volatility

trend_spy_vol15.mechanism: 63/126/252 SPY-minus-BIL trend vote with a 15% target and no leverage

sector_top3_momentum.mechanism: Top three positive-momentum sector ETFs, inverse-volatility weighted, 15% target

cross_asset_top3_momentum.mechanism: Top three positive-momentum cross-asset ETFs, inverse-volatility weighted, 12% target

equity_dual_momentum.mechanism: Best positive 12-month risk-on ETF; otherwise best positive defensive ETF or BIL

sector_breadth_equity_rotation.mechanism: SPY/QQQ relative momentum gated and scaled by nine-sector breadth

fixed_literature_model_ensemble.mechanism: Equal fixed combination of frozen Finly, multi-asset trend, and equity-bond cross-signal weights

equal_weight_expert_ensemble.mechanism: Equal blend of five non-redundant causal experts, re-volatilized to 15%

online_mwu_expert_ensemble.mechanism: Fixed-share multiplicative weighting of five experts using only realized prior-period excess returns

next_required_stage: No registered candidate passed the co-primary raw-return and risk gates; append any new literature/competitor candidate before evaluation.
